Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 851/2023

Dear Ms. Menon,

Thank you for meeting us on 16/12/2023 about your dispute with Kavya Kulkarni. As we understand it, the cheque came back with the remark account closed. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Nagpur.

Our advice is to treat the closure of the account as evidence of dishonest intent and oppose any compounding below the full cheque amount. Please collect the cheque, the return memo showing the account was closed and the loan agreement and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of 25.2 lakh rupees.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Nagpur
